proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ P _ hP
  have hred : IsReduced (Localization.AtPrime P) := isReduced_localizationPreserves P.primeCompl _ inferInstance
  have h := IsLocalization.AtPrime.radical_map_of_mem_minimalPrimes (A := Localization.AtPrime P) P ⊥ hP
  rw [IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq, ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, ← h, Ideal.map_bot, eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
  exact Ideal.mem_bot.2 (IsNilpotent.eq_zero ⟨n, Ideal.mem_bot.1 hn⟩)
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsReduced R] (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime], P ∈ minimalPrimes R → IsField (Localization.AtPrime P)
